classification: Model-assisted read of each registered spell script that still blocks a monster (custom logic, P4, or a combat parameter without an authoring field), with evidence lines; four findings re-read by hand (gorerilla small ring, metal gargoyle curse, icicle heal, gaz'haragoth summon). Proposal for D13 shared parameterized native behaviours; not accepted design.
monster_references: per spell, the number of converted monsters whose manifest it blocks; a monster can count under several spells

patterns.mechanism: On cast, checks a summon-count cap (via getSummons(), a global counter, or a live spectator scan) and spawns N instances of a fixed monster type near the caster, at a random position in a fixed box, or at a fixed position list, usually assigning master ownership.

An area or fixed-position combat/tile scan identifies allied creatures (monsters not owned by a player master, or specific named monsters) and adds positive health to them, sometimes also healing the caster itself.

A plain, non-branching Combat script (no bespoke onCastSpell logic) blocked purely because the authoring schema has no field yet for a specific combat parameter (e.g. COMBAT_PARAM_BLOCKARMOR, COMBAT_PARAM_DISPEL), damage type (e.g. COMBAT_LIFEDRAINDAMAGE), or area constant (a symbolic area name that isn't a literal 0-3 matrix) that the script uses.

The caster announces (say) and/or applies a windup guard, waits a fixed delay (addEvent), then executes a large area or targeted hit computed either via a damage formula or manually per-creature (optionally vocation-filtered for players, with distance falloff/crit or direction-based area selection), sometimes followed by self-removal or a side-effect (heal master, spawn adds).
An area/tile/beam combat scan applies damage specifically to creatures whose name matches a fixed roster (and, in some variants, a smaller generic amount to any player caught in the blast).

The caster heals itself (a random amount, sometimes after a windup delay) when a trigger condition is met -- own health below a percent threshold, or consuming/removing a named ally spawn -- guarded by a one-shot regeneration condition so it cannot re-trigger immediately.
Computes a tile path from caster to the targeted creature, sends a magic effect along each path tile for a visual 'chain' trail, then executes a single-target combat hit against that one target.
Teleports the caster to a fixed position occupied by a mirrored/other instance of itself (or a linked capsule creature), synchronizes health between the two, and swaps back after a fixed delay.
A simple self-targeted repositioning or defensive buff for a boss at hardcoded map coordinates: teleport self, or grant self invisibility, with no target interaction.

Bespoke encounter logic tied to fixed map positions, quest storage values, or global/world state (teleporting players, spawning quest-specific companions, gating on z-level) that does not reduce to any of the other shared mechanisms.
Scans tiles in a radius around the caster for wall/growth-type items (by fixed or symbolic item id) and removes matches, playing an effect.
Combat sets CALLBACK_PARAM_CHAINVALUE/CALLBACK_PARAM_CHAINPICKER so damage actually bounces between qualifying targets a bounded number of times (real multi-target chain, not just a visual trail).
Pre-builds a table of Combat objects, each carrying a CONDITION_CURSED with a staircase of damage ticks that grow by a fixed multiplier (1.2x) every ~4s, and executes one entry chosen at cast time.
A single cast executes two or more independently-shaped Combat objects (different damage types/areas/formulas) together, layering multiple simultaneous attacks from one spell.

A per-tile combat callback scans all creatures on each hit tile and applies a vocation-specific CONDITION_ATTRIBUTES (skill%/magic%/defense% reduction) for a fixed duration, with severity picked from a range table at cast time.
Transforms one or more ground tiles to a hazard/visual item id for a fixed window, then reverts them (directly or via a stored position table) after a delay.
After a short windup delay, applies a CONDITION_FEARED to the target for a fixed duration.
Thin per-target combat callback wrapping the existing engine helper doChallengeCreature to force target aggro for a fixed duration.
A single cast schedules a sequence of independent area-combat waves via addEvent at increasing delays and areas, so the hit expands over time from one trigger.

cap counter (devourerSummon) is a global declared outside this file.

parameters.say: THE GLOOTH GENERATOR CHARGES UP FOR A LETHAL EXPLOSION!

parameters.say: The fully charged generator explodes in a blast!

cap counter (hungerSummon) is a global declared outside this file.
spawn box is a fixed room bounding box, not caster-relative.
cap counter (rageSummon) is a global declared outside this file; no re-trigger delay lock unlike hunger/destruction summon.
no getSummons() cap and no setMaster: unbounded independent hostile spawns every cast, unlike the capped/mastered variants.
Damned Soul summons are never mastered (loose count, no setMaster call) unlike Sin Devourer.
trigger is the caster's own condition state (poisoned/bleeding), not a summon-count cap.

parameters.cap_source: spectator scan for names 'Egg' or 'Spawn Of The Welter' in 50-tile radius

spells.notes: cap check counts live named creatures via Game.getSpectators instead of creature:getSummons(); no setMaster call.

spells.notes: no windup/delay at all: combat:execute and creature:remove() happen in the same statement.

parameters.say: Gaz'haragoth calls down: DEATH AND DOOM!

parameters.area_by_direction: 4 preset line/beam matrices keyed by creature:getDirection()

parameters.range_check: must be within 20 tiles and creature still alive

spells.notes: delay is effectively 0 (addEvent at 1ms): immediate kamikaze explosion, not a real telegraphed windup like the other members of this pattern.

side_effects: teleport all spectators + named boss 'lady tenebris' to fixed room center 32912,31599,14

for loop `for i = 2.32, 2.32 do` runs exactly once (dead/degenerate range vs. ghastly dragon curse's real 40-170 staircase) -- likely an authoring bug, same mechanism otherwise.
same onTargetCreature body as frozen minion beam: enemy players take ice damage, unowned monsters are healed by the same roll.
no Combat object at all: single hardcoded-position tile lookup, not an area/callback based heal like the rest of this pattern.
logs via logger.debug(...) on heal; target,target combat healing call looks like a copy/paste of a player-facing heal callback signature.

parameters.heal_amount: random(200,350) fixed per cast (same roll for all targets + self)

parameters.say_start: Lisa takes a final breath before she's healing up!

parameters.extra_gate: caster must stand on tile with item 1487/1492/1500 (fire)
parameters.say: Omrafir gains new strength from the fire

spells.notes: gate gets checked by hardcoded creature name == 'Omrafir', so this only ever fires for one specific monster.

parameters.say: <the welter devours his spawn and heals himself>

spells.notes: distinct trigger from the rest of this pattern: heals by finding and removing a named ally spawn rather than checking own health%.
three addEvent-scheduled combat waves of increasing radius fired in sequence from one cast.
'COMBAT_PHYSICALDAMAGEDAMAGE' is not a real engine constant (double 'DAMAGE') -- looks like a typo for COMBAT_PHYSICALDAMAGE; script likely silently deals 0 damage in Canary today.

file also registers 2 sibling spells (soulsnatcher-lifedrain-missile, soulsnatcher-manadrain-ball) using standard areas (AREA_CIRCLE3X3 etc.) that are not blocked; only this beam entry uses the unresolved custom area constant.
core player-facing spell (Ultimate Healing), not monster-specific; blocked purely by the same DISPEL schema gap.
thin wrapper around the existing engine helper doChallengeCreature; the only 'custom logic' is the callback registration itself.
also embeds a conditional_summon of 'Rage of Mazoran' x4 inside lavaGrounds(); revert step restores ~900 hardcoded item positions from the itemsRoom table.
